id: 8f2b7c14-6d3a-4e9f-9a21-3b5c8e7d1f04
status: experimental
description: Detects invocation of the YesWiki erasespamedcomments action with clean/suppr deletion parameters, which requires no authorization and permanently deletes arbitrary wiki pages (CVE-2026-52766, fixed in 4.6.6).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6x7x-gcmf-7r8x
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-52766
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/17
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1485
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_method:
    cs-method: 'POST'
  selection_payload:
    c-uri|contains:
      - 'erasespamedcomments'
      - 'suppr['
      - 'suppr%5B'
      - 'clean=yes'
  condition: selection_method and selection_payload
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate wiki administrator running the built-in spam-comment cleanup
level: high
3064.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.uri_query) as uri_query values(Web.status) as status from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=POST AND (Web.url="*erasespamedcomments*" OR Web.uri_query="*erasespamedcomments*" OR Web.url="*suppr*" OR Web.uri_query="*suppr*" OR Web.uri_query="*clean=yes*") by Web.src, Web.dest, Web.url
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| where like(url,"%erasespamedcomments%") OR like(uri_query,"%erasespamedcomments%") OR (like(uri_query,"%suppr%") AND like(uri_query,"%clean%"))
| sort - count

3065.sent:
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where SyslogMessage has "Suppression de la page"
| summarize DeletedPages = count(), SamplePages = make_set(SyslogMessage, 50), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by HostName, ProcessName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where DeletedPages > 5   // >5 confirmed page deletions in a 10-min window — far above manual admin cleanup (typ. 1-3)
| order by DeletedPages desc
3065.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=POST AND (Web.url="*erasespamedcomments*" OR Web.uri_query="*erasespamedcomments*" OR Web.uri_query="*suppr*" OR Web.url="*suppr*") by Web.src, Web.dest, _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| where count > 5
| sort - count

3066.sent:
W3CIISLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where csMethod == "GET"
| where scStatus == 404
| where csUriStem has "wiki" or csUriQuery has "wiki"
| summarize NotFound = count(), DistinctPages = dcount(csUriQuery), Pages = make_set(csUriQuery, 50) by Computer, sSiteName, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where DistinctPages > 10   // >10 distinct previously-served wiki pages now 404 in a 15-min window — deletion aftermath
| order by NotFound desc
3066.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=GET AND Web.status=404 AND (Web.url="*wiki=*" OR Web.uri_query="*wiki=*") by Web.dest, Web.uri_query, _time span=15m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| stats sum(count) as notFound dc(uri_query) as distinctPages values(uri_query) as pages by dest, _time
| where distinctPages > 10
| sort - notFound

3193.sent:
let win = 15m;
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Url has "/api/memories" or Url has "/api/documents/"
| extend Stage = case(
    Url has "/api/memories" and toint(HttpStatusCode) == 401, "probe",
    (Url has "/api/documents/upload" or Url has "/api/documents/batch-upload") and HttpMethod =~ "POST" and toint(HttpStatusCode) == 200, "write",
    (Url has "/api/documents/search-content/" or Url has "/api/documents/history") and HttpMethod =~ "GET" and toint(HttpStatusCode) == 200, "read",
    Url has "/api/documents/remove" and HttpMethod =~ "DELETE" and toint(HttpStatusCode) == 200, "delete",
    "other")
| where Stage != "other"
| summarize Stages = make_set(Stage), ReadCount = countif(Stage == "read"), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by SrcIpAddr
| where Stages has "probe" and Stages has "write" and Stages has "delete"   // full probe->write->destroy chain
| where datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen) <= 900   // 15m window
| order by LastSeen desc
3193.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count as reqCount min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.uri_path) as paths from datamodel=Web where (Web.url="*/api/memories*" OR Web.url="*/api/documents/*") by Web.src Web.http_method Web.status
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| eval probe=if(like(paths,"%/api/memories%") AND status=401,1,0)
| eval wrote=if(match(paths,"/api/documents/(upload|batch-upload)") AND http_method="POST" AND status=200,1,0)
| eval read=if(match(paths,"/api/documents/(search-content|history)") AND http_method="GET" AND status=200,reqCount,0)
| eval deleted=if(match(paths,"/api/documents/remove") AND http_method="DELETE" AND status=200,1,0)
| stats sum(probe) as probe sum(wrote) as wrote sum(read) as readReqs sum(deleted) as deleted min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by src
| where probe>0 AND wrote>0 AND deleted>0 AND (lastTime-firstTime)<=900
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime

3241.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — The SOC Files: ScreenConnect masked as freeware. An inside look at a large-scale
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("install.res.1033.dll", "fj5nmesp9eukrun.ps1", "regasm.exe", "installer_method3_stream.vbs", "cap.ps1", "script.vbs", "obs-studio-installer.exe", "vcredist_x64.dll", "vcredist_x86.dll", "ds4windows.exe", "crosshairx_installer.exe", "jumper.exe", "pro.exe", "processhacker-2.39-setup.exe", "clientservice.exe") or FolderPath has_any ("C:\Users\Public\script.vbs", "C:\Temp\OBS-Studio-Windows-x64\Assets\x86\vcredist_x64.dll"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("C:\Users\Public\script.vbs", "C:\Temp\OBS-Studio-Windows-x64\Assets\x86\vcredist_x64.dll") or FileName in~ ("install.res.1033.dll", "fj5nmesp9eukrun.ps1", "regasm.exe", "installer_method3_stream.vbs", "cap.ps1", "script.vbs", "obs-studio-installer.exe", "vcredist_x64.dll", "vcredist_x86.dll", "ds4windows.exe", "crosshairx_installer.exe", "jumper.exe", "pro.exe", "processhacker-2.39-setup.exe", "clientservice.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3241.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — The SOC Files: ScreenConnect masked as freeware. An inside look at a large-scale ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("install.res.1033.dll","fj5nmesp9eukrun.ps1","regasm.exe","installer_method3_stream.vbs","cap.ps1","script.vbs","obs-studio-installer.exe","vcredist_x64.dll","vcredist_x86.dll","ds4windows.exe","crosshairx_installer.exe","jumper.exe","pro.exe","processhacker-2.39-setup.exe","clientservice.exe") OR Processes.process_path="*C:\Users\Public\script.vbs*" OR Processes.process_path="*C:\Temp\OBS-Studio-Windows-x64\Assets\x86\vcredist_x64.dll*")
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*C:\Users\Public\script.vbs*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*C:\Temp\OBS-Studio-Windows-x64\Assets\x86\vcredist_x64.dll*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("install.res.1033.dll","fj5nmesp9eukrun.ps1","regasm.exe","installer_method3_stream.vbs","cap.ps1","script.vbs","obs-studio-installer.exe","vcredist_x64.dll","vcredist_x86.dll","ds4windows.exe","crosshairx_installer.exe","jumper.exe","pro.exe","processhacker-2.39-setup.exe","clientservice.exe"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]
